summary: Comprehensive test suite organized into three focused levels: unit tests for SemVerBumper module functions, integration tests for the orchestrator script, and workflow structure + act execution tests. All major requirements covered: version parsing (semver, prerelease, build metadata), commit classification (feat/fix/breaking with scopes and footers), version bump logic, file updates (VERSION and package.json), changelog generation, and GitHub Actions workflow validation with real pipeline execution via act. Tests use clear helpers (Invoke-Bumper, New-WorkDir, New-CommitLog), proper TestDrive isolation, and parameterized fixtures. Assertions check exact values, job success, and exit codes. Gaps: some version boundary cases untested (0.x.y, very large numbers, leading zeros), file corruption scenarios absent, a few complex commit message edge cases missing. Fixture files (commits-*.txt, .actrc) are properly referenced by the workflow tests; their presence is assumed given the implementation context. The test design follows red/green TDD and would reliably catch regressions in the core bump logic, file mutations, and CI/CD integration.
